$meta.title: Allotrope protocols — extracted from Build 44
$meta.note: Extracted verbatim from Build 44; Build 44 was not modified. protocols[] are the 30 fully-bound Allotrope workflow templates (4 flagship + 26 catalog). techniqueFamilies[] is the ADF ontology taxonomy — reference only (name strings, one GDTI per family), NOT per-protocol bindings.
$meta.disclaimer: All prefixes are Build-44 representative/illustrative, NOT GEPIR-verified. In particular Honeywell here is 0614141, but the verified Honeywell prefix in the root contract (CLAUDE.md §4) is 0662498 — they DO NOT match. Every protocol is stamped state=candidate, source=build-44-harvest, inferred=true, verified=false per verified-or-exception.
$meta.locationNote: Build 44 binds no location SGLN to any protocol; ownership is expressed as a PGLN. location.sgln is null on every protocol by design, not omission.
